-- Deterministic id generation: same seed, same ids, no capabilities.
-- Intended guarantee for make_ids: the n ids are pairwise distinct.

-- Advances the generator state. A pure function of its input.
step(s: int) -> int =
  pre s >= 0
  post out >= 0
  ex step(0) == step(0)
  (s * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648

-- Returns n distinct ids derived from seed. Same inputs give the same list.
make_ids(n: int, seed: int) -> List[int] =
  pre n >= 0
  post out.len() == n
  ex make_ids(0, 7) == []
  ex make_ids(3, 7) == make_ids(3, 7)
  var out: List[int] = []
  var s = seed % 2147483648
  for i in range(0, n)
    s = step(s)
    out.append(s)
  out
